skills.description: Using an in-cabin DMS camera, the system analyzes the driver's facial video in real time, detects eye open/closed state, calculates blink rate per minute (normal range 15-20 blinks/min), and identifies single-blink closure duration. Application scenarios: passenger cars, commercial vehicles, ride-hailing fleets, freight fleets.
